# OpenMRP Documentation

## API
- [API Keys](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/authentication/api-keys.md): Learn how to authenticate requests with API keys.
- [MCP server](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/mcp/mcp-server.md): Connect AI agents and assistants to the OpenMRP API over the Model Context Protocol.
- [Request logs](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/monitoring/request-logs.md): Monitor and debug your API activity with request logs.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/overview.md): Learn more about OpenMRP's APIs.
- [TypeScript](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/sdks/typescript.md): Call the OpenMRP API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
- [Managing API Keys](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/authentication/managing-api-keys.md): Learn the best practices for managing secret API keys.
- [Audit events](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/monitoring/audit-events.md): An immutable record of every change made in your account — who changed what, when, and from which request.
- [Go](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/sdks/go.md): Call the OpenMRP API from Go applications.
- [Email logs](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/monitoring/email-logs.md): Confirm whether an email OpenMRP sent on your behalf actually went out.
- [API URIs](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/make-requests/api-uris.md): Learn the general format of OpenMRP API URIs.
- [Idempotency](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/make-requests/idempotency.md): Safely retry requests without duplicating work.
- [Rate limiting](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/make-requests/rate-limiting.md): Understand rate limits and implement retry strategies.
- [Pagination](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/make-requests/pagination.md): Iterating through paginated list results.
- [API versioning](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/make-requests/versioning.md): Understand how OpenMRP versions its API and manage version upgrades.
- [Request IDs](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/make-requests/request-ids.md): Use request IDs to debug issues and get support.
- [API errors](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/handling-errors/errors.md): Standard error envelope format for consistent error handling.
- [Include Parameter](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/api/make-requests/include.md): Expand sub-objects in API responses to get the data you need.

## Developer resources
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/developer-resources/index.md): Technical documentation, API references, and guides for developers.

## Get Started
- [API tour](https://docs.augno.com/get-started/get-started/about-the-apis/api-tour.md): See how OpenMRP API objects fit together and learn best practices for combining them effectively.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/get-started/get-started/overview.md): Create an account and learn how to build on OpenMRP.

## Start Building
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/get-started/start-building/account/overview.md): Learn how to activate and manage your OpenMRP account, from initial setup to advanced configurations.
- [Send your first API request](https://docs.augno.com/get-started/start-building/start-developing/api-request.md): Get started with the OpenMRP API.
- [Activate your account](https://docs.augno.com/get-started/start-building/account/activate.md): Learn how to activate and manage your OpenMRP account.
- [Checklist](https://docs.augno.com/get-started/start-building/account/checklist.md): Complete this checklist before putting your OpenMRP account into production.
- [Go live checklist](https://docs.augno.com/get-started/start-building/start-developing/go-live.md): Use this checklist to ensure a smooth transition putting your integration into production.
- [Release phases](https://docs.augno.com/get-started/start-building/start-developing/release-phases.md): Learn how OpenMRP describes product release phases and what to expect from each.

## Automate with agents
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/automate-with-agents/overview.md): Put an AI teammate on the work — in a conversation or on demand, bounded by a role you control.
- [Agents](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/automate-with-agents/agents.md): Define what an agent does, when it runs, how hard it thinks, and what it is allowed to touch.
- [Runs](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/automate-with-agents/runs.md): One execution of an agent, from trigger to answer — and every safety rail around it.
- [Tools & approvals](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/automate-with-agents/tools-and-approvals.md): What an agent is allowed to do, and where a human has to say yes first.
- [Memories](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/automate-with-agents/memories.md): Durable notes your agents recall on later runs — and the first place to look when one starts behaving oddly.
- [Agents in chat](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/automate-with-agents/agents-in-chat.md): Put an agent in a conversation, watch it work, approve what it wants to do, and let it draft the reply to your customer.

## Build products
- [Production Steps](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/bom/production-steps.md): The core building block of manufacturing in OpenMRP - defining inputs, outputs, and costs for each stage of production.
- [Inventory Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/inventory/inventory.md): Real-time visibility into every unit of material, part, and product - what you have, where it is, and what it costs.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/items/overview.md): Materials, parts, and products - the core objects you buy, make, and sell in OpenMRP.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/overview.md): Purchasing, manufacturing, production tracking, and inventory management.
- [Machines and departments](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/plant/machines-and-departments.md): The equipment and functional areas that scheduling, the status board, downtime and OEE all key on.
- [Production schedules](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/production-planning/production-schedules.md): Versioned, constraint-based plans that decide what each machine makes, and in which week.
- [Production Runs](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/production/production-runs.md): Coordinated manufacturing executions that group related batches and track progress from start to completion.
- [Suppliers](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/purchasing/suppliers.md): Vendors you purchase materials from, defining the source for your raw material procurement.
- [Scanning Stations](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/scanning/scanning-stations.md): Configured points in your production workflow where batch operations happen - each linked to a specific operation type and production step.
- [Consumptions & Productions](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/bom/consumptions-and-productions.md): The inputs and outputs of each production step - what materials are used up and what parts or products are created.
- [Storage Locations & Lots](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/inventory/storage-and-lots.md): Where inventory is physically stored and how batch-level traceability is maintained.
- [Materials](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/items/materials.md): Raw materials and supplies you purchase from vendors for use in production.
- [Machine status and downtime](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/plant/machine-status-and-downtime.md): A live board of what every machine is running, and the stoppage log that turns OEE availability into a measurement.
- [Publishing and releasing](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/production-planning/publishing-and-releasing.md): How a draft plan becomes a commitment, and how one week of it becomes work on the floor.
- [Batches](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/production/batches.md): Physical units of product tracked through production - recording quantities, quality grades, and location as they move through manufacturing.
- [Purchase Orders](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/purchasing/purchase-orders.md): Transaction records for buying materials from suppliers, tracking orders through delivery and fulfillment.
- [Labels](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/scanning/labels.md): Batch identification labels printed at scanning stations - two formats and four sizes for production floor tracking.
- [Production Flows](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/bom/production-flows.md): The connected sequence of production steps that transforms raw materials into finished products.
- [Inventory Change Logs](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/inventory/change-logs.md): A complete audit trail of every inventory movement - who changed what, when, by how much, and why.
- [Parts](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/items/parts.md): Intermediate items you manufacture or assemble from materials during production.
- [Demand overrides](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/production-planning/demand-overrides.md): Tell the planner about demand your order history cannot see.
- [Batch Operations](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/production/batch-operations.md): Initialize, move, split, and merge - the core actions that advance batches through the production flow.
- [Deliveries & Receiving](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/purchasing/deliveries-and-receiving.md): Track the physical arrival of materials from suppliers and convert purchase order quantities into usable inventory.
- [Costing (COGS)](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/bom/costing.md): Real-time cost of goods sold calculation from production step definitions - material, labor, and overhead costs.
- [Reconciliation & Bulk Updates](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/inventory/reconciliation.md): Correct inventory counts when the system and physical reality diverge, with full audit trail logging.
- [Products](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/build-products/items/products.md): Finished goods you price, stock, and sell to customers.

## Collect payments
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/collect-payments/collecting/collecting.md): Record the money received from customers and apply it to open invoices through transactions and settlements.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/collect-payments/overview.md): Learn about collecting payments in OpenMRP.
- [Settlements](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/collect-payments/collecting/settlements.md): Formally record which transactions pay which invoices by creating settlements with allocations.
- [Invoicing](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/collect-payments/invoicing/invoicing.md): Invoices are the billing records OpenMRP generates for each shipment, capturing what was shipped, to whom, and for how much.
- [Accounts receivable](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/collect-payments/accounts-receivable/accounts-receivable.md): Track what customers owe, how long balances have been outstanding, and take action to collect.

## Communicate
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/communicate/overview.md): Conversations, customer cases, notifications, and email inside OpenMRP.
- [Messages](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/communicate/messages.md): Direct messages, group threads, and the discussions attached to your business records.
- [Inbox](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/communicate/inbox.md): Customer-service cases, triage lanes, assignment, and the reply-approval loop.
- [Notifications](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/communicate/notifications.md): The in-app bell feed, account announcements, and per-user notification preferences.
- [Email](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/communicate/email.md): Bridge a domain you own into OpenMRP so customer mail opens a case and your team replies from your own address.
- [Retention & compliance](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/communicate/retention-and-compliance.md): Hold a conversation for litigation, erase its contents on request, and know exactly what the retention worker deletes.

## Dashboards
- [Accounts receivable](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/financial/accounts-receivable.md): An aging report showing what customers owe across current, 30, 60, 90, and 120-day buckets.
- [Demand forecast](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/forecasting/demand-forecast.md): Forecast demand, order revenue, and sales revenue with confidence intervals based on historical data.
- [Delivery analytics](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/operations/delivery-analytics.md): Track on-time delivery rates, average delivery time, and time to first shipment with period-over-period comparison.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/overview.md): Analytics and reporting dashboards that give you real-time visibility into sales, operations, finances, and forecasting.
- [Order analytics](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/sales/order-analytics.md): A comprehensive view of sales performance with profit metrics, cumulative revenue, best sellers, and distribution breakdowns.
- [Payments data](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/financial/payments-data.md): View payment allocations across invoices with support for invoice and balance view modes.
- [Sales targets](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/forecasting/sales-targets.md): View and create revenue targets for sales reps by month.
- [Manufacturing analytics](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/operations/manufacturing-analytics.md): OEE and schedule performance for one production week, measured against the plan that was live at the time.
- [Order data](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/sales/order-data.md): A raw, line-level data grid of all sales transactions with Excel export.
- [Material analytics](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/operations/material-analytics.md): View material inventory levels, demand, and reorder needs by supplier.
- [Quarterly orders](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/sales/quarterly-orders.md): Visualize order quantity trends by quarter across multiple years.
- [Products on order](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/sales/products-on-order.md): View open orders, back-order quantities, and top ordered products at a glance.
- [Weeks of sales](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/dashboards/sales/weeks-of-sales.md): See how many weeks of inventory you have on hand based on recent sales velocity.

## Generate sales
- [Customer prices](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-pricing/customer-prices.md): Define product-line-specific pricing for individual customers, overriding base product prices.
- [Customer groups](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/customer-groups.md): Classify customers by segment and control which pricing and discounts they receive.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer/customer.md): The central record connecting sales orders, invoices, shipments, and payments.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/overview.md): Customers, pricing, orders, and the sales team - everything that drives revenue in OpenMRP.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/sales-order/sales-order.md): The central order for selling products to a customer, driving fulfillment from creation through payment.
- [Territories](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/sales-team/territories.md): Map geographic regions to sales representatives, optionally scoped by product line.
- [Volume discounts](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-pricing/volume-discounts.md): Automatically reduce pricing based on order quantity with tiered percentage discounts.
- [Shipping terms](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/shipping-terms.md): Define who pays for freight, how charges are calculated, and when freight is waived.
- [Create a customer](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer/create.md): Learn how to create a customer in OpenMRP.
- [Create a sales order](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/sales-order/create.md): Learn how to create a sales order in OpenMRP.
- [Sales targets](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/sales-team/sales-targets.md): Define revenue goals for sales reps over a date range, optionally by product line.
- [Discount codes](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-pricing/discount-codes.md): Promotional codes applied at the order level to reduce the total by a percentage or fixed amount.
- [Payment terms](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/payment-terms.md): Define when and how a customer is expected to pay for an order.
- [Contacts](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer/contacts.md): Manage the people associated with a customer and control who receives order confirmations and invoices.
- [Generate a production run](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/sales-order/generate-production-run.md): Generate a production run from a sales order in OpenMRP.
- [Priorities](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/priorities.md): Control order-processing precedence to determine which work gets attention first.
- [Issue a sales order](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/sales-order/issue.md): Learn how to issue a sales order in OpenMRP.
- [Account statuses](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/account-statuses.md): Control whether a customer can place orders and receive shipments.
- [Commission & freight exemption](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/exemptions.md): Exclude customers or customer groups from commission calculations and freight charges.
- [Customer portal](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-portal.md): A branded, self-service portal where your customers register, place orders, submit payments, and track inventory.
- [Default sales reps](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/default-sales-reps.md): The team member automatically assigned to new orders for a customer.
- [Default carriers & options](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/default-carriers.md): Define the shipping carrier and service level automatically applied to a customer's orders.
- [Addresses](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/generate-sales/customer-setup/addresses.md): Billing and shipping locations for customers, used on orders, invoices, and shipments.

## Workflows
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/index.md): End-to-end guides for common business processes in OpenMRP.

## Manage your account
- [Your profile](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/account-settings/profile.md): Update your display name, email address, and profile photo.
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/overview.md): Configure your account settings, team, integrations, security, and billing.
- [Team members](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/team/team-members.md): Invite, manage, and remove the people who use your OpenMRP account.
- [Business information](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/account-settings/business-information.md): Configure your account name, logo, contact details, and portal slug.
- [Security](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/security.md): Manage your password and keep your account secure.
- [Roles and permissions](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/team/roles-and-permissions.md): Control what team members and API keys can access with granular, role-based permissions.
- [Plans & billing](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/plans-and-billing.md): View your subscription, switch plans, and manage billing through Stripe.
- [Sandboxes](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/sandboxes.md): Create isolated testing environments to develop and experiment without affecting production data.
- [API keys](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/api-keys.md): Create, rotate, and revoke API keys for programmatic access to OpenMRP.
- [Integrations](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/integrations.md): Connect third-party services like Stripe, Shippo, and HubSpot to your OpenMRP account.
- [Customer portal](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/customer-portal-settings.md): Control how your customer portal looks and the address customers reach it on.
- [Support](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/manage-account/support-routing.md): Choose the group whose members receive the messages customers send from your portal.

## Ship products
- [Overview](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/ship-products/overview.md): Learn about shipping products in OpenMRP.
- [Picking](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/ship-products/picking.md): Select and pull the right products from inventory to fulfill a sales order.
- [Packing](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/ship-products/packing.md): Pack picked items into shipping cases and create shipments ready for the carrier.
- [Shipping](https://docs.augno.com/workflows/ship-products/shipping.md): Generate shipping labels, assign tracking numbers, and ship packed orders through your carrier.

## API Objects

### AI
- [Agent object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/agent-definition.md): An AI agent available to the account.
- [Agent Memories object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/agent-memory.md): A piece of information an agent has saved for recall in future runs.
- [Agent Runs object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/agent-run.md): A single execution of an agent, from trigger through completion.

### Auth
- [API Key object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/api-key.md): An API key used to authenticate requests to the OpenMRP API.

### Core
- [Audit Event object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/audit-event.md): An immutable record of a single change to a resource, capturing who made the change, what changed, and when.
- [Email Logs object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/email-log.md): A record of an email the platform sent on the account's behalf, such as an order acknowledgement or a user invitation.
- [Jobs object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/job.md): Records a piece of work the API accepted and carries out asynchronously.
- [Request Log object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/request-log.md): A log of a single API request, capturing its route, outcome, latency, and actor.
- [Sandbox object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/sandbox.md): An isolated test account owned by a production account.

### Catalog
- [Item Categories object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/item-category.md): A grouping of related catalog items that defines the unit group and properties available to the items within it.
- [Items object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/item.md): An entry in your catalog: something you sell, consume, or build with.
- [Materials object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/material.md): A material in the account's catalog: a raw material or component consumed in production.
- [Parts object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/part.md): A part in the account's catalog: a component used in production.
- [Product Lines object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/product-line.md): A named grouping of related products in your catalog.
- [Products object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/product.md): A catalog entry as it is sold: an inventory item together with its product type, product line, and customer portal visibility.
- [Properties object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/property.md): A named characteristic used to classify items, such as `Color` or `Size`.
- [Unit Groups object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/unit-group.md): A named collection of units that share one dimension, defining which units a product can be ordered in.
- [Units object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/unit.md): Unit of measurement used for conversions and product quantities.

### Finance
- [Payment Terms object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/payment-term.md): A payment term describing when payment is due (e.g.

### Identity
- [Account Users object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/account-user.md): A user's membership in an account, carrying the account-specific status, role, and department.
- [Roles object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/role.md): A named set of permissions that can be assigned to users to control what they can access.

### Messaging
- [Announcements object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/announcement.md): A broadcast announcement shown in the notification (bell) feed, carrying the calling user's own read state.
- [Conversations object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/conversation.md): A conversation thread the caller participates in.
- [Email Domains object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/email-domain.md): A domain registered with the email bridge for sending and receiving mail.
- [Email Inboxes object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/email-inbox.md): A routable email inbox on a verified domain.
- [Messages object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/list.md): A single page of resources, together with the metadata needed to page through the rest of the result set.
- [Messaging Groups object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/messaging-group.md): A reusable roster: a named set of members (users and/or agents) that seeds new conversations.
- [Notifications object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/notification.md): An in-app notification addressed to a single user, shown in their notification (bell) feed.

### Operations
- [Carriers object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/carrier.md): A shipping carrier configured for fulfilling orders.
- [Demand Overrides object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/demand-override.md): An adjustment to the demand a production schedule is planned against.
- [Departments object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/department.md): A functional area of a production operation, such as fabrication or packaging, that groups scanning stations and machines.
- [Location object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/location-type.md): A level in the storage location hierarchy, such as a building or a bin.
- [Machine Downtime object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/machine-downtime-event.md): A period during which a machine was not running.
- [Machines object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/machine.md): A piece of production equipment, such as a CNC router or press, assigned to a department.
- [Operating Calendars object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/operating-calendar.md): OperatingCalendar is the set of days one party to a shipment operates.
- [Production Schedules object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/production-schedule.md): A saved production schedule.
- [Scanning Stations object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/scanning-station.md): A station on the production floor where operators scan batches to perform a batch operation, such as initializing or moving a batch.
- [Service Levels object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/service-level.md): A shipping speed or method offered by a carrier, such as ground or overnight.
- [Shipping Terms object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/shipping-term.md): A named freight pricing rule that decides what a buyer pays for shipping.

### Sales
- [Account Groups object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/account-group.md): A named grouping of customer accounts, used for pricing rules or to categorize accounts.
- [Account Prices object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/account-price.md): A customer-specific price for a product line.
- [Account Statuses object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/account-status.md): A lookup value describing the standing of a customer account, such as whether shipments or all activity should be held.
- [Address object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/address.md): A saved address that can be used for billing and shipping on sales orders, invoices, and shipments.
- [Customers object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/customer.md): A business you sell to, with its contact details, default fulfillment settings, and order policies.
- [Order Discounts object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/order-discount.md): A discount code that can be applied to a sales order.
- [Priorities object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/priority.md): Priority level used to order work on sales orders, purchase orders, and picks.
- [Sales Orders object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/sales-order.md): An order placed by a customer, tracked from estimate through fulfillment.
- [Volume Discounts object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/volume-discount.md): A quantity-based discount with tiered percentage rates.

### Settings
- [Portal Domains object](https://docs.augno.com/api-reference/objects/portal-domain.md): A custom domain that serves the account's customer portal (e.g.
